name: JUSD
oneLiner: JUSD is an issuer-managed dollar stablecoin with crypto collateral and protocol-managed reserve liquidity; redemption backstop is not source-verified by Pharos.
collateral: Self-described "diversified reserve of high-quality assets" managed by the issuer; the 2023 whitepaper claims supply is minted/burned as the issuer adds or reduces backing assets but names no specific reserve assets, custodians, or amounts and publishes no attestation.
pegMechanism: Dollar stable token with issuer/protocol-managed collateral and liquidity processes described by JUSD; no Pharos redemption backstop is modeled until the exit route is source-reviewed

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: reviewed metadata indicates a direct issuer, admin, proxy, pause, burn, or upgrade control surface beyond reserve-only exposure.

notices.title: Redemption backstop not modeled
notices.message: JUSD metadata is tracked from public materials, but Pharos has not source-reviewed a holder-exercisable redemption route for backstop scoring.

mintAuthority.summary: JUSD is an issuer-managed, self-described asset-backed dollar token on BSC and Polygon; the whitepaper says supply is adjusted through smart-contract mint/burn when backing assets change, but no audited attestation or holder-exercisable redemption route is published.

controls.label: JUSD issuer mint/burn authority
controls.evidence: JUSD materials describe issuer-controlled mint/burn with periodic supply adjustment aligned to a claimed asset reserve; supply creation is centralized to the issuer with no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route documented.

review.evidence: JUSD's public site and whitepaper describe a centrally issuer-managed asset-backed stablecoin with smart-contract mint/burn and reserve-adjustment language across BSC and Polygon, but no audited reserve attestation or holder redemption route was found; issuance is treated as issuer-controlled.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Issuer-managed mint/burn taken from JUSD's public site and whitepaper; the on-chain token owner/minter admin and any reserve backing are unverified.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain JUSD owner/minter admin on BSC and Polygon and whether any audited reserve actually backs issued supply.
